svg.title: LINES / Grid map
svg.desc: A 16-column, 8-row Grid with square pads on an equal horizontal and vertical pitch. Colors identify control groups, not physical LED colors. Coordinates are column then row; bottom-right 16,8 is the navigation modifier.

g.text: T1–T8: one row per track. Repeated labels are the column functions.
R: ratchet on/off / hold to freeze its value
P: probability on/off / hold to freeze its value
Choose one rate per track; blank col. 8
